regime: Trend-Down Reversal (Risk-Off, AI-Capex Selloff, Vol Rising)
summary: The reclaim failed in a single session. NQ gave back both green days and more, down 3.10 percent to 29,092, breaking its opening range down and losing both its ATR stop and EMA50. This was a tech and AI story: renewed AI-capex worries and the reaction to megacap earnings hit the Nasdaq hardest, while ES held up far better at off 1.23 percent. Gold got sold too, down 2.86 percent to 4,040, which reads as cash-raising rather than a safe-haven bid. VIX jumped back to 19 and crude was the only green market on the board.

event.consensus: The federal data calendar stays thin and unreliable under the shutdown backdrop, so scheduled releases were not the driver.
event.actual: A tech-led risk-off reversal. Renewed AI-capex and valuation worries, together with the reaction to megacap-tech earnings, drove the Nasdaq sharply lower.
event.surprise: Two up days reversed hard in one session. NQ led the drop, ES held up far better, gold sold off in the deleveraging, and VIX jumped back toward 19.
event.nqReaction: NQ fell 3.10 percent, broke its opening range down at 14:30 UTC, lost its ATR stop and EMA50, and closed 29,092.25 near the session low.
event.crossAsset: MES minus 1.23 percent at 7,703.75. December gold minus 2.86 percent at 4,039.90. December crude plus 1.40 percent at 99.09, the one green market. VIX 19.03, up 14.1 percent.

risk.sizing: Defensive. The trend flipped down and stops are broken, so no new longs and reduced size overall.
risk.openRisk: NQ and MES lost their ATR stops and EMA50 and gold is below its stop, so the only trend intact is crude to the upside. A tech-led break can spread, so treat bounces as suspect until a stop is reclaimed.
risk.note: Throttle state DEFENSIVE. No drawdown flags and the daily loss budget is unused, but the trend flipped down hard: NQ lost its stop and EMA50 on a 3.10 percent drop, MES broke its stop, and gold sold off with stocks. No new longs here. The long-only momentum edge (E3v2) is blocked with price below EMA50 and ROC negative. TSMOM can work the short side while price stays below the stops (MNQ 29,392, MES 7,733, gold 4,082), but keep size small into a fast tape. Crude is the exception, back above its 98.26 stop, with January now on MCL2!. VIX at 19 is the volatility the momentum edge wants, but it cuts both ways in a fast market. The data calendar stays thin with the shutdown, so treat any headline as the catalyst. Next policy event is the FOMC meeting Oct 27 to 28.

psychology: Yesterday the lesson was not to size up on a two-day reclaim. Today is why. The reclaim that looked real on Wednesday's close was gone by Thursday's open, and chasing it would have put you long right into the break. The job on a day like this is simple and hard: respect the level that broke. When price loses the stop and the mean and keeps going, that is the market telling you the trend flipped, not offering a discount. Stand aside, keep size small, and let the dust settle before you decide the selloff is done.

fullReport.title: NY Opening Range / HTA OPEN (MNQ)
fullReport.html:
Trend-down break that held. OR High 29,589.75, OR Low 29,346.50, Width 243.25 pts (0.82 percent).

Break DOWN at 14:30 UTC at 29,309. Price stayed below the range and closed 29,092.25 below it, below NYVWAP 29,230.81 and HOF VWAP 29,209.78. It is Thursday, so there are no day-of-week blocks: HOF and MID are back online and BIR and BNC are eligible. The clean short-only hand-off set up on the down break. There was no BIR because price closed below the range rather than back inside.
